printer.title: Printer
printer.summary: Printers made in the last ten years usually print without a driver. Older models need one from their maker or from Gutenprint.
steps: Choose Install and set up, and pick a driver. Omarchy installs it and adds the printer to CUPS.
If it can't match a driver to the model, Print Settings opens: choose Add, pick the printer, and select its model or the closest one in the same series.
Print from any app.
For a printer on the network, open Print Settings and choose Add: most network printers are listed without a driver.

printer.ipp.title: Driverless printer
printer.ipp.summary: This printer speaks IPP over USB, so it prints without a driver once ipp-usb shares it with CUPS, and scans without one too if it is a printer that scans.
steps: Choose Install and set up to install ipp-usb. If the printer also scans, pick the option with Document Scanner.
Unplug the printer and plug it back in.
Print from any app: the printer shows up in the print dialog on its own.

options.label: Driverless printing and scanning with ipp-usb, sane-airscan and Document Scanner, for a printer that scans (Arch repositories)

printer.04b8.title: Epson printer
printer.04b8.summary: Epson publishes its own open source driver (ESC/P-R). It is not in Omarchy's repositories, so it comes from the AUR, or from Epson's download site.
steps: Choose Install and set up, and pick a driver. Omarchy installs it and adds the printer to CUPS.
If it can't match a driver to the model, Print Settings opens: choose Add, pick the printer, and select its model or the closest one in the same series.
Print from any app.
Models from about 2019 on (EcoTank ET-, WorkForce WF-) use the ESC/P-R 2 driver.

options.label: Epson ESC/P-R 2 driver, for models from 2019 on (AUR)

printer.03f0.title: HP printer
printer.03f0.summary: HP's HPLIP drivers cover printing and scanning on most HP printers.
steps: Choose Install and set up, and pick a driver. Omarchy installs it and adds the printer to CUPS.
If it can't match a driver to the model, Print Settings opens: choose Add, pick the printer, and select its model or the closest one in the same series.
Print from any app.

options.label: HPLIP with SANE and Document Scanner, for a printer that scans (Arch repositories)

printer.04f9.title: Brother printer
printer.04f9.summary: Brother laser printers work with brlaser, from the AUR. Brother publishes Linux drivers for its inkjets and the rest.
steps: Choose Install and set up, and pick a driver. Omarchy installs it and adds the printer to CUPS.
If it can't match a driver to the model, Print Settings opens: choose Add, pick the printer, and select its model or the closest one in the same series.
Print from any app.

printer.04a9.title: Canon printer
printer.04a9.summary: Canon PIXMA printers use Canon's cnijfilter2 driver, from the AUR (x86_64 only) or Canon's support site. Gutenprint covers many older models.
steps: Choose Install and set up, and pick a driver. Omarchy installs it and adds the printer to CUPS.
If it can't match a driver to the model, Print Settings opens: choose Add, pick the printer, and select its model or the closest one in the same series.
Print from any app.

printer.04e8.title: Samsung printer
printer.04e8.summary: Samsung laser printers work with the SpliX driver, from the AUR. Samsung printers are supported by HP now.
steps: Choose Install and set up, and pick a driver. Omarchy installs it and adds the printer to CUPS.
If it can't match a driver to the model, Print Settings opens: choose Add, pick the printer, and select its model or the closest one in the same series.
Print from any app.

scanner.title: Scanner
scanner.summary: SANE drives most scanners, and Document Scanner is a simple app to scan with.
steps: Choose Install and set up, and pick what to install. Omarchy installs it with Document Scanner and lets you use the scanner right away.
Open Document Scanner.

scanner.ipp.title: Driverless scanner
scanner.ipp.summary: This scanner speaks eSCL over USB, so it scans without a driver through ipp-usb and sane-airscan.
steps: Choose Install and set up, and pick what to install. Omarchy installs it with Document Scanner and lets you use the scanner right away.
Open Document Scanner.

options.label: Driverless scanning with ipp-usb, sane-airscan and Document Scanner (Arch repositories)

scanner.04b8.title: Epson scanner
scanner.04b8.summary: Most Epson scanners work with SANE's built-in epson2 and epsonds backends.
steps: Choose Install and set up, and pick what to install. Omarchy installs it with Document Scanner and lets you use the scanner right away.
Open Document Scanner.
If Document Scanner finds nothing, try Epson Scan 2 instead.

scanner.04f9.title: Brother scanner
scanner.04f9.summary: Brother scanners need Brother's SANE backend, brscan4 in the AUR (newer models: brscan5), also on Brother's site.
steps: Choose Install and set up, and pick what to install. Omarchy installs it with Document Scanner and lets you use the scanner right away.
Open Document Scanner.

options.label: Brother brscan4 with SANE and Document Scanner (AUR)
Brother brscan5, for newer models, with SANE and Document Scanner (AUR)
Download the scanner driver from Brother

camera.title: Camera
camera.summary: Cameras and phones sharing photos over PTP open in the file manager once gvfs-gphoto2 is installed.
steps: Choose Install and set up.
Open the file manager: the camera is listed in the sidebar.

iphone.title: iPhone or iPad
iphone.summary: An iPhone or iPad shares its photos and files once usbmuxd and the Apple file protocol are installed.
steps: Choose Install and set up.
Unlock the device and tap Trust.
Open the file manager: the device is listed in the sidebar.

options.label: usbmuxd and the Apple file protocol (Arch repositories)

smartcard.title: Smart card reader
smartcard.summary: Smart cards, ID cards and security keys used as smart cards need the PC/SC daemon and its USB driver.
steps: Choose Install and set up: it installs the PC/SC daemon and starts it.
Insert the card and use it from the browser or the app that asks for it.

options.label: PC/SC daemon and CCID driver (Arch repositories)

serial.title: Serial device
serial.summary: Boards and adapters that show up as a serial port (Arduino, ESP32, 3D printers, USB-serial cables) can be used once your user joins the uucp group.
steps: Choose Install and set up to join the uucp group.
Log out and back in.
The device is /dev/ttyACM0 or /dev/ttyUSB0 for your app.

options.label: Add me to the uucp group

displaylink.title: DisplayLink dock or adapter
displaylink.summary: DisplayLink screens need DisplayLink's driver. It is not in Omarchy's repositories, so it comes from the AUR.
steps: Choose Install and set up, or download the driver from DisplayLink.
Reboot.

fingerprint.title: Fingerprint reader
fingerprint.summary: Fingerprint readers work through fprintd. Omarchy's fingerprint setup installs it, enrolls a finger, and lets it unlock the screen, sudo and polkit.
steps: Choose Install and set up, and follow the fingerprint setup's prompts.

fingerprint.touchid.title: Touch ID
fingerprint.touchid.summary: Linux can't use Touch ID on Apple Silicon Macs yet: the sensor sits behind Apple's Secure Enclave, which Linux does not drive so far. There is nothing to install for it today.
steps: Use your password to unlock and authorize, or a FIDO2 security key from Setup > Security > Fido2.
Omarchy will offer fingerprint setup here once Linux supports the sensor.

unknown.title: Device without a driver
unknown.summary: Linux loaded no driver for this device. It may need one from its maker, or an app that talks to it directly.
steps: Look the device up by its ID ({id}) on linux-hardware.org to see what others use with it.
Search the Arch Wiki for its name.
Install what they recommend with omarchy pkg add, or omarchy pkg aur add for AUR packages.
